hooks.name: Pre-push Lint and Test
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to run lint, type-check, and tests before any git push or commit operation.

action.prompt: Before any git push or git commit command, ensure the following checks pass first: ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy --ignore-missing-imports, and pytest. If any check fails, fix the issue before proceeding with the git operation.
